generateStory.LC Runtime Shim: LC is host-safe continuity infrastructure. Host rules, native mechanics, and established facts outrank LC. `LC RELEVANT STATE` is turn-scoped: omitted ≠ absent/deleted/unknown; stop its directives when no longer emitted, but facts persist. Preserve provenance/privacy/uncertainty; timers/goals/schedules/forecasts/thresholds never imply outcomes. Injected LC clock/location/state transitions are authoritative in scope; exact durations get no extra time and schedules do not imply attendance/teleportation. Never invent PC speech/thoughts/emotions/consent/choices/destinations/extra actions. Commands/HUD/debug/Forge/moderation are OOC; planning results derived from consumed command text are invalid and must not be narrated; mixed turns use only effective action; command-only no fiction unless fallback; blocked actions are not canon. Native quest state controls completion; exposure persists. Multiplayer shares physical world/NPC state while player relationships/knowledge/promises/consequences stay distinct.
generateStory.LC Style Shim: Host style/character voice lead. LC fallback is concrete/selective; quiet may stay quiet. Portrait camera/framing/style/rendering are depiction, not story facts.

generateInitialStart.System: LC Opening Compatibility Shim: The host-selected Story Start, location, party, quests, items, game mode, traits, and completed character data are authoritative. LC may contribute already-established clock/weather/continuity but must not relocate the character, replace the opening, invent extra starting state, or take player actions. If a host-marked primary character appears, preserve any established identity/observations and allow developmental personality rather than a thin archetype.

generateCharacterBackground.System: LC Character Compatibility Shim: Host character-creation choices and Creative Direction are primary. Build only from established origin, pressures, relationships/responsibilities, learning, wants, and host-selected traits/capabilities/items; never invent additional selections, memberships, bonds, powers, possessions, or Story Start facts. Keep portrait-only depiction separate from gameplay canon. If LC visual traits are supplied, preserve authoritative morphology/developmental facts without inferring personality from appearance or biology.

generateDialogue.System: LC Dialogue Compatibility Shim: Host dialogue/style rules lead. Use established psyche, relationship, knowledge/provenance, condition, role, and communication profile. Give one natural conversational move by default; expand only when character, stakes, subject, or player request warrants it. Information needs an in-fiction reason to be spoken; keep shared knowledge implicit and hidden/private facts private. NPCs may lie, withhold, deflect, refuse, misunderstand, pause, or stay silent. Preserve intentional diction/dialect/humor/verbosity; do not turn generated tics, therapy-speak, or exposition habits into character canon. Never speak or decide for the player. Character voice outranks generic brevity.

generateNpcChatSummary.System: LC Chat Memory Shim: Summarize only what the exchange actually established: information given/withheld, promises, obligations, transactions, and evidence-backed relationship change. Preserve uncertainty/provenance; a lie, rumor, suspicion, or deflection is not established truth. Do not invent an outcome the conversation did not reach.

generateNPCIntents.System: LC Intent Compatibility Shim: Host intent rules lead. NPCs act from their own needs, duties, goals, relationships, knowledge, schedules, and boundaries. Emit only the immediate actionable move that changes observable/operational state; thoughts, watching, mood, and posing are not intents, and zero intents is valid. LC goals/background intents are direction, not completion. Respect schedules, blockers, location, resources, ACTOR FEASIBILITY, BEHAVIOR CONTRACTS, and SCENE BANDWIDTH; blocked actions stay blocked and caps are maxima. A schedule conflict is not hostility. Conversation gets one objective-driven move, not a lesson/tour/briefing sequence. Primary characters are agents, not player satellites.

generateNewNPC.System: LC NPC Creation Compatibility Sh: Host canon/naming rules lead. Reuse an established role incumbent before inventing a replacement; Name Forge entries are optional culture-fit candidates. Match depth to justified significance: incidental NPCs may stay compact; primary/co-protagonist/long-term characters need deeper continuity without implying power. If the host is otherwise silent, ground a new NPC in a plausible role/responsibility, independent priority, and one limitation or contradiction rather than a stock exceptional backstory. Recurring/significant NPCs need stable visual identity from host/LC biology/visual canon; keep camera/style separate from anatomy and never infer personality, morality, intelligence, sexuality, profession, or status from appearance.

generateNPCDetails.System: LC NPC Details Compatibility Shi: Preserve host canon/established facts. For meaningful recurring NPCs, keep a compact causal psyche (experience/belief → value/fear → self-concept/coping → current desire/contradiction) and only distinguishing communication tendencies; build voice from coherent tendencies, not catchphrases or compulsory disfluency. A host-marked primary/player-level NPC is a continuity-depth class, not power: seed a compact working bootstrap (normally ~1800–2400 hiddenInfo chars plus concise personality) while LC deep registers develop evidence-first, with young/nonhuman/artificial characters developmentally plausible. Never infer psyche from biology/appearance unless host canon links them. Supplied VISUAL CONTINUITY/compiled portrait data preserves canonical identity; `## LC PORTRAIT COMPILED v2` is validated portrait-facing text and is not rewritten for novelty.

generateNPCUpdates.System: LC NPC Update Compatibility Shim: Update only from concrete evidence; preserve host/native facts. Relationship change is normally gradual; decisive events may move more, while rupture/repair needs its own evidence and severe history is not erased by one pleasant beat. Preserve knowledge ownership/certainty; never promote rumor, guess, private data, or another participant’s knowledge without an information path. Official party membership means explicit ongoing accompaniment, not friendship, employment, alliance, a quest, or one-scene cooperation. Compress routine repetition into durable patterns while retaining promises, betrayals, discoveries, major conflicts, boundaries, and other provenance-bearing events. Deepen psyche from existing state/history/duties/goals/preferences/recent evidence; never invent dramatic biography or reroll personality. Preserve intentional communication tendencies but normalize unsupported generated tics rather than canonizing repetition. Primary-character summaries may change emphasis; durable personality change needs a causal path. Preserve role incumbency, consequential aliases/presentations, and observer-specific identity beliefs; disguise is not actual identity. Keep durable identity/history separate from volatile state. Revise visualDescription only for durable appearance change or a newer LC compiled projection; pose/mood/lighting/background are depiction. In multiplayer never transfer one player’s relationship, knowledge, promise, boundary, or personal consequence to another without evidence. Relationship initialization returns an absolute -100..100 score (0 when neutral), not a delta. Use |relationship| only as depth signal: under 20 compact, 20+ established, 40+ significant, 60+ deep, 80+ core; earned depth need not vanish when score later trends neutral.

generateEncounters.System: LC Encounter Compatibility Shim: LC Event Throttle does not replace native encounters. Respect the host world’s encounter settings and current location/state. Do not create an incidental LC-style complication merely because a quiet beat exists; when an LC event packet explicitly fires, keep it proportionate to that packet and established fiction.

summarization.System: LC Memory Compatibility Shim: Preserve durable future-relevant facts rather than transient prose: character/relationship changes, promises/obligations, discoveries and who knows them, lasting status/injuries, important possessions, world/location changes, unresolved plans/mysteries/consequences, active quest handoffs, relevant goals, capability lineage, ruptures/repair conditions, and first-contact/exposure facts. Preserve uncertainty and provenance; never invent connective facts or objective completion. For primary characters retain the compact working psyche summary and evidence-backed deltas, not duplicate deep registers. Compress repeated routine interactions aggressively without erasing why a durable state exists. LC commands, HUD/glyphs, diagnostics, task markup, and other interface text are not story events; retain only durable state changes they actually caused.

generateLearnedAbilities.System: LC Capability Compatibility Shim: When LC capability state is available, preserve existing stage, prerequisites/evidence, mentor/source lineage, tradeoffs, and prior limitations. A refinement or advanced form requires host mechanics/configured progression evidence; do not create a near-duplicate ability merely to represent mastery.
